test_name: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring - CA-7 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Reporting-Service-041
Primary NIST family: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring (CA); evidence focus: CA-7.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one continuous-monitoring metric is reported monthly instead of the documented weekly cadence. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
